explanation: He woke up with the melody in his head and spent weeks asking friends whether he had copied it from somewhere. Until he found proper words, he sang 'scrambled eggs' over it.

claims.text: The working title of the Beatles song Yesterday was Scrambled Eggs.
Scrambled Eggs was not the working title of Let It Be, Hey Jude or Michelle.
Paul McCartney said he woke up with the melody of Yesterday in his head.
McCartney spent weeks asking people whether the melody of Yesterday already existed.
